payload.title: Artifact transfers use application authorization
payload.description:
As an authenticated Plexus user or workload, I want artifact transfers authorized by Plexus, so that large workflow artifacts move without exposing cloud credentials.

Feature: Authorized artifact transfer tickets

Scenario: Request a valid transfer
Given an authenticated Cognito user or IAM workload owns the requested resource
When it requests a supported artifact transfer
Then GraphQL returns a canonical object key and a short-lived signed HTTPS request
And the caller cannot choose an arbitrary bucket or object path

Scenario: Reject an unauthorized transfer
Given the caller does not have access to the resource or artifact type
When it requests a transfer ticket
Then the request is rejected without returning a signed URL

Scenario: Transfer integrity fails
Given transferred bytes do not match the declared SHA-256 or size
When the artifact store validates the transfer
Then the operation fails closed
And it does not fall back to inline data or direct S3 access.
